Hello, this is Claire Bennett from the London office. I am calling about the due diligence call on Thursday. I have already read your firm profile, and I have shared it with two colleagues here. Before we talk, I would like to understand your career trajectory a little better. How long have you worked in tax law, and when did you move from audit? I have also sent you three questions about the regulatory framework in Brazil. We have not agreed on the scope of the advisory mandate yet, so please follow up on that with my assistant. Thank you, and speak on Thursday.

Hi, it is Daniel from the tax team. Quick update before the client call. I have just finished the compliance review, and I have sent the memo to the client this morning. Two things. First, the reform milestone moved again, so the committee has not published the final text yet. Second, I carried out the impact analysis last week, and the tax exposure is lower than we expected. I have not spoken to the client about that yet, because I wanted us to be on the same page first. Can you call me before three o'clock? Thanks.

I started my career in audit, where I worked for four years. After that, I moved to a large bank and I learned how a bank really thinks. I joined my current firm in 2016, and a few years later I became a partner. Since then, I have led advisory mandates for banks and payment companies.
